summary: The PR addresses the issue of missing gid in SVG output for AnnotationBbox, but there are some concerns about test coverage and potential side effects.

issues.description: There are no new tests added to verify that the gid is correctly included in the SVG output for AnnotationBbox.
The change might introduce behavioral regression if other parts of the rendering process rely on the current behavior of not opening/closing groups for AnnotationBbox.
